units.source_text: 夕雾离开一条院，立刻来到前太政大臣邸内。

en.t: Yugiri left Ichijo-in and immediately went to the residence of the former Grand Minister.

units.source_text: 但见柏木的诸弟都在座，他们都说：“请到这里来！”

en.t: There he found all of Kashiwagi's younger brothers seated, and they said, "Please come over here!"

units.source_text: 他就走进大臣的客厅中。

en.t: So he went into the minister's reception room.

units.source_text: 大臣暂时抑制哀情，与夕雾相见。

en.t: The minister held back his grief for a while and received Yugiri.

units.source_text: 这位大臣虽然上了年纪，相貌一向同青年人一样漂亮，但此次也消瘦衰老了。

en.t: Although this minister was advanced in years and had always looked as handsome as a young man, this time he too had grown thin and aged.

units.source_text: 胡须也无心剃，长得很长。

en.t: He had no heart to shave his beard, and it had grown very long.

units.source_text: 竟比以前遭父母之丧时更加憔悴。

en.t: He looked even more haggard than he had when he lost his parents long before.

units.source_text: 夕雾一见这岳父的模样，悲痛难忍，簌簌地流下泪来。

en.t: When Yugiri saw his father-in-law in such a state, he could not bear the sorrow and tears fell thick and fast.

units.source_text: 自觉不好意思，便努力隐藏。

en.t: Feeling embarrassed, he tried hard to hide them.

units.source_text: 大臣想起夕雾是柏木的好友，见了面只管淌眼泪，怎么也止不住。

en.t: Remembering that Yugiri had been Kashiwagi's close friend, the minister could do nothing but weep when he saw him, and he could not stop.

units.source_text: 谈起柏木的事，话语滔滔不绝。

en.t: When he began speaking of Kashiwagi, his words poured out without end.

units.source_text: 夕雾把访问一条院之事说给他听。

en.t: Yugiri told him about his visit to Ichijo-in.

units.source_text: 大臣的眼泪越发像春雨连绵时的檐漏一样掉个不住，衣衫都湿透了。

en.t: The minister's tears fell all the more without stopping, like drops from the eaves in a long spring rain, until his robes were soaked through.

units.source_text: 夕雾把落叶公主的母夫人所咏“柳眼”之诗写在怀纸上，呈与大臣观看。

en.t: Yugiri wrote on folded paper the poem on "willow eyes" composed by Princess Ochiba's mother and showed it to the minister.

units.source_text: 大臣说：“我的眼睛也看不见了！”

en.t: The minister said, "My eyes too can no longer see!"

units.source_text: 拼命擦了一会眼泪，然后看诗。

en.t: He wiped away his tears desperately for a while, and then read the poem.

units.source_text: 那哭丧着脸阅读时的相貌中，全无从前那种精明能干、轩昂磊落的痕迹，

en.t: As he read with that tearful face, there was no trace left of his former sharp ability or noble openness,

units.source_text: 教人看了不成体统。

en.t: and the sight seemed painfully unbecoming.

units.source_text: 此诗并非特别优越，

en.t: The poem was not especially outstanding,

units.source_text: 惟“露珠穿”之句颇有意味，

en.t: but the phrase about stringing dewdrops had considerable charm,

units.source_text: 大臣读了不胜伤感，眼泪久不能止。

en.t: and when the minister read it, he was overcome with sorrow, and his tears would not stop for a long time.

units.source_text: 对夕雾言道：“你母亲逝世那年秋天，

en.t: He said to Yugiri, "In the autumn of the year your mother passed away,

units.source_text: 我以为悲伤已达极点。

en.t: I thought my grief had reached its utmost limit.

units.source_text: 然而妇女行动范围有限，相识的人较少，

en.t: Yet women have a limited sphere of movement and know fewer people,

units.source_text: 无论何种情况之下，总不亲身出面。

en.t: and whatever the situation, they do not appear personally in public.

units.source_text: 因此这悲伤是隐藏的，并不到处触发。

en.t: Therefore that sorrow stays hidden and is not stirred up everywhere.

units.source_text: 但男子就不同，

en.t: But with men it is different,

units.source_text: 柏木虽然并不能干，也蒙皇上不弃，

en.t: for although Kashiwagi was not especially capable, the emperor did not cast him aside,

units.source_text: 官位晋升以来，仰仗他的人自然渐次增多，

en.t: and after he rose in rank, the number of people who relied on him naturally increased little by little,

units.source_text: 闻耗而惊叹惋惜的人，各方面都有。

en.t: so there are people in every quarter who were shocked, lamented, and mourned when they heard the news.

units.source_text: 但我之所以深感悲恸者，

en.t: But the reason I feel such deep grief

units.source_text: 并非为了世间一般的威望与官位，

en.t: is not because of ordinary worldly reputation or rank,

units.source_text: 只是想起了他那美玉无瑕的身体，

en.t: but only because I remember his body, flawless like a precious jewel,

units.source_text: 悼念不已耳。

en.t: and cannot cease mourning him.

units.source_text: 世间何物可以解除我的悲痛呢？”

en.t: What in this world could relieve my sorrow?"

units.source_text: 说罢仰起头来，怅望天空，

en.t: After saying this, he lifted his head and gazed sorrowfully at the sky,

units.source_text: 但见暮云暗淡，樱花将谢，

en.t: where the evening clouds were dim and the cherry blossoms were about to fall,

units.source_text: 他今天还是初次看到这景色呢。

en.t: and today was the first time he had noticed this scene.

units.source_text: 就在夕雾的怀纸上写道：

en.t: Then he wrote the following on Yugiri's folded paper:
